See also: numerología, numerológia, and numerologią

Finnish

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈnumeroˌloɡiɑ/, [ˈnume̞ro̞ˌlo̞ɡiɑ̝]
  • Rhymes: -oɡiɑ
  • Syllabification(key): nu‧me‧ro‧lo‧gi‧a
  • Hyphenation(key): nu‧mero‧logia

Etymology 1

[edit]

Internationalism (see English numerology). Contains the suffix -logia.

Noun

[edit]

numerologia

  1. numerology

Italian

numerologia
Wikipedia it

Etymology

[edit]

From numero +‎ logia. Compare English numerology, Polish numerologia.

Noun

[edit]

numerologia f (plural numerologie)

  1. numerology

Polish

[edit]
Polish Wikipedia has an article on:
numerologia
Wikipedia pl

Etymology

[edit]

Internationalism; compare English numerology, Italian numerologia. By surface analysis, numer +‎ -o- +‎ logia.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /nu.mɛ.rɔˈlɔ.ɡja/
  • Rhymes: -ɔɡja
  • Syllabification: nu‧me‧ro‧lo‧gia

Noun

[edit]

numerologia f

  1. numerology

[edit]

singular
nominative numerologia
genitive numerologii
dative numerologii
accusative numerologię

locative numerologii
vocative numerologio
